name: Question 4
problem:
Find the Laplace transform $Y(s)=L{y(t)}$ for $s>3$ if 

$$
{y}^{′}+y=-8\operatorname{cosh}⁡3t,\,y(0)=1.
$$

You may make use of the following result:

$$
L{\operatorname{cosh}⁡\omega t}=\frac{s}{{s}^{2}-{\omega }^{2}},\,s>|\omega |.
$$

Question 4
?

Find the Laplace transform Y(s)=L{y(t)} for s>3 if y′+y=−8cosh⁡3t,y(0)=1. You may make use of the following result: L{cosh⁡ωt}=ss2−ω2,s>|ω|.

a
Y(s)=ss2+9
b
Y(s)=ss2−9
c
Y(s)=s−9s2+9
d
Y(s)=s−9s2−9
e
Y(s)=s+9s2−9
Submit
